## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan along D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking discriminator

> **05:26** · landau-fan: n fast [-1.25,+3.25]e12 91 pts (0.05e12) co-swept (TG,BG) on run-5 D=0 line; B slow 1->10 T uniform-1/B 140 rows (F\_Nyq 77 T, dF 1.11 T); sr1 200 uV (20 kOhm FS); ends 10 T, gates park 0 · **ETA ~11:26** (≈6h)

Plan step 4 (operator-requested next move). Runs 6/7 (ana cells 14–15) show textbook SdH on both carrier signs but the spot FFT resolution (dF ≈ 4.3 T) cannot separate the candidate ABAB heavy fundamental (≈ 25.6 T at n = +3.2×10¹²) from the 3–4× harmonics of the dominant 7.1 T light tone. The fan resolves this three ways: fundamentals **disperse with n** while harmonics stay integer-locked to their parent; the branch **partition ΣFᵢ(n) vs F_L(n) = 10.34·n[10¹²] T** distinguishes two-band ABAB (sum rule) from single-branch ABCA from an asymmetric/gapped ABCB; and the **CNP column R(B)** reads the D = 0 gap. Region-B mosaic tones (+13 % n, run 5) are a known contaminant to check per column.

**Design.** Fast axis: n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 0.05 steps (91 pts), (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept on the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line — spans the full validator-allowed window, both carrier signs (nothing excluded; the hole side simply ends at the TG −0.3 V limit). Slow axis: B = 1 → 10 T **uniform in 1/B**, 140 rows (Δ(1/B) = 6.5×10⁻³ → F_Nyq = 77 T ≈ 2× the highest observed content; per-column FFT dF = 1.11 T separates 25.6 T from 28.4 T). Ascending from the magnet's current 0 T (never re-traverse); ends at **10 T** with gates parked at 0. Below-1 T content (run-6 light-tone onset ≤ 0.3 T) is traded out: covering 0.5–1 T at this Nyquist doubles the row count (~+4 h) and adds onset/mass information, not frequency-structure information. sr1 fixed at 200 µV (20 kΩ FS): sized to the unknown CNP column at high B; a rail there is accepted and is itself a gap statement.

**Price** (calibrated on run 5: 1.10 s/pt in-row at fast_delay 1.0, ~6 s turnaround): 140 × (91 × 1.10 + 9) s ≈ 4.2 h in-row + 66 min ramps (9 T at 0.137 T/min) + 7 min initial 0→1 T ≈ 5.6 h → quoted **6 h** (session actuals run over the bracket). **Checkpoints:** first rows (~12 min in: signal, leakage, sensitivity, B tracking); then at ~2 T (row ~78, ≈ 2.7 h) and ~4 T (row ~117, ≈ 4.3 h) — partial per-column FFT on landed rows: are branches dispersing with n? continue / abandon call at each (abort ≈ `nb-collab interrupt`, partial fan keeps its data). hera-watch armed on the run dir.

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---

B_vec = field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 140)                  # uniform in 1/B: d(1/B) = 6.5e-3 -> F_Nyq = 77 T; FFT dF = 1.11 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() >= 0.99
